text:
Marta (People Ops): Heads up — we have a visiting partner arriving at 3pm (Team Verdant). They requested a small welcome basket and a potted plant in the meeting room. Can someone grab a plant from the lobby stash? :seedling:
Alyssa: I can swing by the lobby on my way in. What size plant are we thinking? small/medium?
Marta (People Ops): Small is fine. Also need a temporary visitor badge and a table with 4 chairs in Conf B. Front desk said the badge printer is acting up this morning.
Jamal: I just fixed the badge printer last week but it did the same thing earlier — spits out blank lanyard strips. Error in the logs was `PRINTER_ERROR: inkline-00x`. I can be at front desk at 2:40 to test.
FrontDesk-Bot: New visitor pre-reg received for "Team Verdant — Jenkins". Badge QR generated but status: "PENDING_PRINT".
Samir: I have an extra welcome basket (snacks + postcards) in my desk if we want to use that.
Alyssa: Perfect — can we add a small note? "Welcome, Team Verdant! — Redwood"
Marta (People Ops): Yes please. Jamal, if you can confirm the printer by 2:45 that'd be great. If still busted, we'll do paper badges and a steward at the door to check IDs.
Jamal: Will test and report. If it fails I’ll run `lpstat -p` and switch to backup printer `badge-2`.
Courier (FedEx): Heads-up — I dropped a small crate at reception for Samir with promo samples. Marked fragile.
Samir: Got it, leaving it at my desk now. Thanks!
Alyssa: Quick seating poll — Conf B has bench + round table vs high-top + stools. Which do we want for an external partner meeting?
Marta (People Ops): Round table please — easier for notebooks and plants. :white_check_mark:
Alyssa: Round table it is. Also, Jamal — huge thanks for stepping in last-minute for the badge printer issue earlier this week. Saved our demo run. :raised_hands:
Jamal: Thanks! Team effort. I’ll ping when printer test is done (2:45-2:50 window).
FrontDesk-Bot: Badge printer status: `TEST_OK` at 14:47.
Marta (People Ops): Awesome, thank you all. I’ll assemble the basket and drop the plant in Conf B at 2:55. If anyone wants to help with quick gift-wrap, meet at the kitchenette at 2:50. :coffee:
Alyssa: I’ll bring tape.
Samir: I’ll bring scissors.
Marta (People Ops): Meeting ops done — closing thread.
